latest AS (
  SELECT r.meter_urn,r.meter_domain,r.meter_role,r.equipment_group,r.equipment_name,r.building_code,r.anomaly_priority,
    count(e.*) FILTER (WHERE e.consumed_at >= now() - interval '15 minutes') AS events_15m,
    count(e.*) FILTER (WHERE e.consumed_at >= now() - interval '1 hour') AS events_1h,
    max(e.event_ts) AS latest_event_ts,
    max(e.consumed_at) AS latest_consumed_at,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(e.consumed_at)) AS consumed_age_sec,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM max(e.consumed_at) - max(e.event_ts)) AS latest_source_to_consume_sec,
    COALESCE(max(e.policy_lookup_status), 'no_recent_event') AS policy_lookup_status,
    (max(e.consumed_at) IS NULL OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(e.consumed_at)) > 900) AS stale_gt_15m
  FROM meter_registry r
  LEFT JOIN live.measurement_event e ON e.meter_urn = r.meter_urn AND e.consumed_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  GROUP BY r.meter_urn,r.meter_domain,r.meter_role,r.equipment_group,r.equipment_name,r.building_code,r.anomaly_priority
) SELECT count(*) AS critical_stale_meters FROM latest WHERE anomaly_priority <= 2 AND stale_gt_15m;
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(consumed_at)), 999999) AS db_write_freshness_sec FROM live.measurement_event;

latest AS (
  SELECT r.meter_urn,r.meter_domain,r.meter_role,r.equipment_group,r.equipment_name,r.building_code,r.anomaly_priority,
    count(e.*) FILTER (WHERE e.consumed_at >= now() - interval '15 minutes') AS events_15m,
    count(e.*) FILTER (WHERE e.consumed_at >= now() - interval '1 hour') AS events_1h,
    max(e.event_ts) AS latest_event_ts,
    max(e.consumed_at) AS latest_consumed_at,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(e.consumed_at)) AS consumed_age_sec,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM max(e.consumed_at) - max(e.event_ts)) AS latest_source_to_consume_sec,
    COALESCE(max(e.policy_lookup_status), 'no_recent_event') AS policy_lookup_status,
    (max(e.consumed_at) IS NULL OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(e.consumed_at)) > 900) AS stale_gt_15m
  FROM meter_registry r
  LEFT JOIN live.measurement_event e ON e.meter_urn = r.meter_urn AND e.consumed_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  GROUP BY r.meter_urn,r.meter_domain,r.meter_role,r.equipment_group,r.equipment_name,r.building_code,r.anomaly_priority
) SELECT meter_domain || ' active<=5m' AS metric, count(*) FILTER (WHERE consumed_age_sec <= 300) AS value FROM latest GROUP BY meter_domain
UNION ALL SELECT meter_domain || ' registered' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM latest GROUP BY meter_domain ORDER BY metric;

latest AS (
  SELECT r.meter_urn,r.meter_domain,r.meter_role,r.equipment_group,r.equipment_name,r.building_code,r.anomaly_priority,
    count(e.*) FILTER (WHERE e.consumed_at >= now() - interval '15 minutes') AS events_15m,
    count(e.*) FILTER (WHERE e.consumed_at >= now() - interval '1 hour') AS events_1h,
    max(e.event_ts) AS latest_event_ts,
    max(e.consumed_at) AS latest_consumed_at,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(e.consumed_at)) AS consumed_age_sec,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM max(e.consumed_at) - max(e.event_ts)) AS latest_source_to_consume_sec,
    COALESCE(max(e.policy_lookup_status), 'no_recent_event') AS policy_lookup_status,
    (max(e.consumed_at) IS NULL OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(e.consumed_at)) > 900) AS stale_gt_15m
  FROM meter_registry r
  LEFT JOIN live.measurement_event e ON e.meter_urn = r.meter_urn AND e.consumed_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  GROUP BY r.meter_urn,r.meter_domain,r.meter_role,r.equipment_group,r.equipment_name,r.building_code,r.anomaly_priority
) SELECT meter_urn, meter_domain, meter_role, equipment_group, building_code, anomaly_priority, events_15m, events_1h, latest_event_ts, latest_consumed_at, consumed_age_sec, latest_source_to_consume_sec, policy_lookup_status, stale_gt_15m
FROM latest
WHERE ('${meter_urn:raw}' = 'All' OR meter_urn = '${meter_urn:raw}')
ORDER BY anomaly_priority, consumed_age_sec DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 81;

SELECT event_ts AS time, meter_urn || ' / ' || measurement AS metric, value_numeric AS value
FROM live.measurement_event
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ('${meter_urn:raw}' = 'All' OR meter_urn = '${meter_urn:raw}')
  AND ('${measurement:raw}' = 'All' OR measurement = '${measurement:raw}')
ORDER BY time;

SELECT consumed_at AS time, meter_urn || ' / ' || measurement AS metric, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM consumed_at - event_ts) AS value
FROM live.measurement_event
WHERE consumed_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ('${meter_urn:raw}' = 'All' OR meter_urn = '${meter_urn:raw}')
  AND ('${measurement:raw}' = 'All' OR measurement = '${measurement:raw}')
ORDER BY time;

SELECT consumed_at, event_ts, meter_urn, measurement, kafka_topic, kafka_partition, kafka_offset, business_idempotency_key
FROM live.measurement_event
WHERE consumed_at >= now() - interval '1 hour'
  AND ('${meter_urn:raw}' = 'All' OR meter_urn = '${meter_urn:raw}')
ORDER BY consumed_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT created_at AS issue_ts, 'meter_tag' AS source, tag AS issue_kind, meter_urn, measurement, detail
  FROM qa.meter_tag
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT created_at AS issue_ts, 'bad_row' AS source, reason AS issue_kind, NULL::text AS meter_urn, NULL::text AS measurement, source_file || ':' || source_row_no::text AS detail
  FROM qa.bad_row
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
) q
ORDER BY issue_ts DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE (stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' OR stage LIKE 'aws_24h_%' OR run_id LIKE 'aws_24h_%') AND metric_name IN ('consumer_processed','consumer_inserted','consumer_duplicate','consumer_retry','consumer_dlq','consumer_committed','consumer_lag_after') GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1), pivot AS (
  SELECT metric_name AS metric, max(metric_value) AS value
  FROM ops.pipeline_metric
  WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest)
    AND metric_name IN ('consumer_processed','consumer_inserted','consumer_duplicate','consumer_retry','consumer_dlq','consumer_committed')
  GROUP BY metric_name
)
SELECT metric, value FROM pivot ORDER BY metric;

WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE (stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' OR stage LIKE 'aws_24h_%' OR run_id LIKE 'aws_24h_%') AND metric_name IN ('consumer_processed','consumer_inserted','consumer_duplicate','consumer_retry','consumer_dlq','consumer_committed','consumer_lag_after') GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1), pivot AS (
  SELECT
    max(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='consumer_processed') AS processed,
    max(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='consumer_inserted') AS inserted,
    max(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='consumer_duplicate') AS duplicate,
    max(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='consumer_dlq') AS dlq,
    max(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='consumer_committed') AS committed
  FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest)
)
SELECT COALESCE(processed,0) - COALESCE(inserted,0) - COALESCE(duplicate,0) - COALESCE(dlq,0) AS invariant_delta,
       COALESCE(committed,0) - COALESCE(processed,0) AS commit_delta
FROM pivot;
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(metric_value), 0) AS value FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE metric_name = 'consumer_retry' /* consumer_retry ops.pipeline_metric */
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(metric_value), 0) AS value FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE metric_name = 'consumer_dlq' /* consumer_dlq ops.pipeline_metric */
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(metric_value), 0) AS value FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE metric_name = 'consumer_duplicate' /* consumer_duplicate ops.pipeline_metric */
